properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705011), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 301 King St, 313 units and completed in Q4 2006 per AvalonBay's Q4 2006 earnings release (the Assessor roll for parcel 8705011 also shows 313 units and a 2006 year built); architect not confirmed by any source found. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. In DataSF's Assessor parcel data, four lots (8705011, 8705012, 8705013 and 8705014), all addressed 301 King St, share this footprint, and the Assessor roll lists one parcel, 8705011, with 313 units; no per-unit condominium lots were found. A city building permit for this address (DBI 200105249986) lists 174 dwelling units where the Assessor roll and AvalonBay's release list 313; the difference is unresolved.
properties.notes: AvalonBay's releases name this building 'Avalon at Mission Bay North II'. That it is one of three AvalonBay phases along King St is not stated by any source read, and 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' is Pier & Point's label.
